item.title: Pearl Research Park - Vellore Institute of Technology
item.description: Pearl Research Park would be the biggest building complex at VIT so far and will house the Industry Technology Park and various Research centres. It will also include smart class rooms, multipurpose gallery halls, cafeterias and faculty offices. We anticipate that the pearl research park will witness research, innovation and industrial collaboration like never before.

item.title: Prof. Mookambeswaran A Vijayalakshmi from VIT is a world-renowned scientist - Vellore Institute of Technology
item.description: IIT Madras Foundation proudly presents Prof. Mookambeswaran A Vijayalakshmi, who is a world-renowned scientist in separation sciences and molecular interactions, is the Founder Director of the Centre for Bioseparation Technology (CBST) at VIT.

item.title: VIT Alumnus recognized as the Best Performing IAS Officer - Vellore Institute of Technology
item.description: VIT feels proud as its Alumnus, Mr. Rachit Raj, IAS, has been recognised as the "Best Performing IAS Officer" of Gujarat State, as per the CM Dashboard, which closely monitors the working of various government offices and the development of district level activities under different schemes launched by the state government.

item.description: 3D printing will evolve to play a major role in mitigating the spread of coronavirus, say researchers from VIT, Prof. Dr. Murugan Ramalingam, Centre for Biomaterials, Cellular & Molecular Theranostics (CBCMT), and Rohin Shyam, Ph.D. Scholar.

item.title: Connecting Science & Society is the need of the hour - Vellore Institute of Technology
item.description: Established in the year 1831, Leibniz University Hannover is a Public University located at Germany. Part of the prestigious TU9 (Alliance of 9 leading technical Universities in Germany), Leibniz University Hannover is known for its strong research, academic delivery & diversity.
